brand: 밀도 — 연남동 소금빵집. 매일 새벽 네 시에 굽고 하루 세 번, 다 팔리면 문을 닫는다. 국산 밀·발효 버터·굵은 소금.

brief.title: 07:00 — First bake, low in the frame
brief.prompt: 07:00. Lower-right salt-roll: torn-tip, scorched-seam, crumbs. Foreground-cropped chipped-bowl; ash-table. 80mm takes precedence. "Camera: 90mm macro at f/4 for a single hero item or 50mm at f/5.6 for a table; camera at 30–45° above the table (never 90° top-down unless the world is brutal), tripod." "Light: Backlight-key: a soft window or 1×1 m diffusion behind and 45° to one side of the food so steam, crumbs and glaze rim-light; white fill card from the front at 2:1 to open the shadows. Small black flag to keep the front from going flat. Steam only if the food is actually hot in the story." Editorial still-life photography, one cohesive series, shot on medium format with a 80mm lens. Color grading: warm neutral base, a single accent hue close to #b45309, low saturation, no neon. Lighting: soft directional window light from the left, bright and airy, gentle long shadows, no flash. Texture: fine film grain, matte surfaces, shallow depth of field on the subject only. No people, no faces, no hands, no body parts anywhere in the frame. No text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermarks, no frame or border. Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.
brief.negative: People, faces, hands, body parts; text, lettering, signs, logos, watermarks, borders; additional rolls, repeated bread, extra props, packaging, visible lighting equipment; centred or symmetrical arrangements, floating food, overhead views; steam from cooled bread; varnish-like glaze, evenly spaced salt, excessive salt, plastic highlights, orange-heavy grading, neon, CGI surfaces. Keep the bowl empty and the upper-left third free of objects and crumbs. Do not substitute a 90mm or 50mm lens for the locked 80mm.

tells: roll segments read as separate pieces, melted seam
window blown to pure white, no detail
bowl awkwardly cropped, adds nothing
crust texture smoothed, render-ish
claude.fix: Move the window into soft focus with texture and shoot one intact roll, drop the bowl.

tells: Oversized foreground plate competes with the low-set bread.

astra.fix: Remove the foreground plate, retaining the low camera and directional sunlight.
